source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Siddhant Bhoite's 5-Sep validation batch, 26 cards. 266 exclusion rows added and 23 removed (net 1,981 -> 2,224), 13 milestones added, 24 card fields corrected, and his highlights and pros/cons written on 19 cards. NOT ONE reward_rule was added, deleted, renamed or re-rated: total_reward_rules is unchanged at 1,305 and every rule_name string is byte-identical, because the app keys each user's saved cap progress on that string. Every reward-rule problem his documents surfaced is written up in the pull request for a human to action, not applied here. Only 'mcc' and 'category' exclusion rows were written - the two the shipped engine reads; an 'other' or 'txn_type' row is inert and would look like coverage without being any. Conditional exclusions ('utilities except through the Airtel Thanks app') were REFUSED rather than filed flat, because the engine tests exclusions before any reward rule and a flat row would delete the card's own headline benefit. Four exclusions were REMOVED from EazyDiner IndusInd Platinum that were silencing three of that card's own reward rules (L6.RULE_EXCLUDED_BY_OWN_CARD 2 -> 1).
